import java.util.Scanner;

public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();
        int insertions = countInsertions(s, 0);
        System.out.println(insertions);
    }

    private static int countInsertions(String s, int index) {
        if (index >= s.length()) {
            return 0;
        }
        int end = index;
        while (end < s.length() && s.charAt(end) == s.charAt(index)) {
            end++;
        }
        int runLength = end - index;
        int count = (runLength % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        return count + countInsertions(s, end);
    }
}
